description: Read-only. Finds links by text across slug, title, destination (longUrl), campaign and tags, or by an exact tag or campaign, including paused and inactive links (status: all). Use it for "which links point at /summer", "every link tagged diwali" or "links in the spring campaign". Reads the workspace's links export, so it needs an owner's or admin's secret key.

campaign.description: Only links in exactly this campaign

query.description: Text to find (case-insensitive) in slug, title, longUrl, campaign or tags

status.description: active (default), inactive (paused or disabled) or all

tag.description: Only links with exactly this tag

name: search_links
title: Search links
